what: Compact per-case summary of the milestone10 C run of the 131-case plan (harness/out/c-m10/g-c, not in Git). With current-m9-c-summary.json it re-derives the behaviour-change set against the milestone9 run and the death counts.

build_id.note: The identity of the C binary the 131-case matrix actually ran against, read from the raw suite manifest. This is NOT the later clean C-BUILD_ID (ef8b063, binary 9432ca12...), which was built afterwards for the remaining checks; see MATRIX-C-BUILD_ID and C-BUILD_ID. The C source was byte-identical in both builds (the same source_sha256), so the matrix result is unaffected. Recorded after review finding M10-R-01.
